messages:
Alex M: Heads-up — pulled a sample and found ~120 accounts marked "Onboarded" that haven't had a single first-touch event in 30+ days. Healthscore math is treating missing telemetry as decay and they're sliding into red. Not a product issue, just noisy signals.
Priya R: Ugh. Do we know if these are real customers or test/seed accounts? Can you share the filter?
Alex M: Query I used:```sql
SELECT id, account_stage, last_touch_at FROM accounts
WHERE account_stage = 'onboarded' AND last_touch_at IS NULL
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
Jamie (CS Ops): Nice catch. Two quick ideas: 1) add a playbook guard to suppress auto-escalation for accounts with no verified billing or no prod usage tag; 2) add a tagging job to mark obvious test imports (email domain like @example.local).
Taylor - Onboarding: Most of the ones I scanned are partner imports from the early pilot. They never received our setup checklist. We should stop churn nudges but also surface them in a manual review queue.
Priya R: I can add a soft-suppress flag in CRM (field: cs_auto_suppress = true) for the batch. Can we push a one-off script?
Jamie (CS Ops): Yes. Suggested playbook condition snippet for automation rule:```yaml
when:
  - account.stage == "onboarded"
  - account.cs_auto_suppress == true
  - account.last_touch_days > 30
then:
  - action: mark_playbook.suppressed
  - reason: "suppress churn nudges for pilot/imports until manual review"
```
Alex M: Can someone run the suppression script and also enqueue these accounts into the "onboard-manual-review" list? We want a human to triage before any renewal outreach.
cs-bot: Automation job #8421 completed: 120 accounts flagged with cs_auto_suppress=true, enqueued -> onboard-manual-review (link: https://console.redwood/test-queue/8421) :white_check_mark:
Taylor - Onboarding: I'll take first pass on the review queue tomorrow morning. If any look like legit active customers, we can flip the flag and re-trigger the healthscore calc.
Priya R: Patch for playbook deployed to staging. I'll push to prod after Taylor confirms a small sample. PR: https://git.redwood/cs/playbooks/pulls/67 :rocket:
Jamie (CS Ops): FYI let's also add a healthscore override audit so we can track when we suppress vs when we actually correct telemetry. Small schema: override_reason, overridden_by, override_expires_at.
Alex M: Agree. Please make sure the audit is visible in the Console under per-account timeline. We keep needing to answer exec questions about sudden healthscore drops.
Taylor - Onboarding: Will do. Thanks all — feels much better than letting automated renewal nudges annoy partners. :relieved:
Alex M: Thanks team. If anyone spots more noisy cohorts, toss them here or create a playbook dry-run.
cs-bot: Reminder: Playbook dry-run scheduled tonight 23:00 UTC. Results will be posted in #customer-success tomorrow morning.
